_comment: Copy to DIRECTOR/director_work.json. DeepSeek Harness edition: schema_version is the config format tools understand (1). Skipped in this edition: window (Claude context-window threshold; DSH compacts automatically), plugins_off, hooks, protect_director, director_worktree (Claude Code hook settings; DSH has no hooks). trace_id_pattern: regex for the requirement or decision IDs that work orders list in TRACES_TO; trace_report.py flags IDs that do not fit. Use the project's own IDs. mode: general or beginner, picked right after the starting prompt (docs/12); tools do not read it. po_pending_files / po_item_pattern / po_open_pattern: where metrics_report.py counts PO entries.
_comment_sdd: ds.2 spec-first (docs/13): every switch defaults to on when missing. Set one to false (a limit to 0) only with a reason in DIRECTOR_LOG. openspec_bin: path to openspec(.cmd), %VAR% expanded. Lookup (2.2.3-ds.3, sdd_gate.py --which): OPENSPEC_BIN, then this, then %LOCALAPPDATA%/dw-ds-tools/openspec-*/node_modules/.bin/openspec.cmd (newest), then openspec on PATH. BOOTSTRAP writes the found path here. When the CLI is found, the lead may not turn require_spec_* off without a PO_PENDING answer from the PO.
_comment_resume: 2.2.2-ds.3 (upstream 2.2.2) RESUME_STATE size: max_bytes / max_line_bytes are read by gate_check --resume (shadow, --strict fails), dsh_setup_check and memory_size_check --kind resume. resume_archive.py never moves the newest keep_recent sections and Before: chain entries (by count, never by age; there is no keep_days) nor a section whose heading holds a protect_headings word (docs/06b).
_comment_base_ref: 2.2.2-ds.3 gate_check.py --order compares the order's BASE_REF commit with the remote branch. check: run it; fetch: git fetch first (false = compare with the local copy, said in the output); strict: a stale or missing BASE_REF or a failed fetch fails (same as --strict-base).
_comment_release: 2.2.2-ds.3 tools/release.py (optional; these are the defaults). title: {version} is filled in. selftest: a command line run in the repo. gh_repo: owner/name, null = from the remote URL.
